description: Use this when the user asks who can make a custom part, or needs a manufacturer, factory or machine shop: CNC machining, sheet metal, injection molding, casting, PCB fabrication and assembly, wire harnesses, 3D printing and more, in a country or region (China, US, Mexico, Canada, Taiwan, Vietnam and others). Searches Maglev's network of 912 manufacturers and returns matching shops with processes, materials, country and state or province, certifications, MOQ, production lead-time and quote-turnaround bands, and whether they take small first runs. Each shop has its name and a ref; Maglev requests the quotes (see how_to_quote). At most 50 shops per request: page with next_cursor. No key needed. Pass a plain-language query, structured filters, or both.

certifications.description: A shop must hold all of these.

countries.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes or names, e.g. ["MX"] or ["Mexico", "Canada"].

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous answer, with the same other arguments.

lens.description: Origin lens, as in search_parts: any, cn (China incl. HK), not-cn, us, usmca (US/CA/MX), allied.

materials.description: Ranks shops that state these materials first. Does not filter.

processes.description: A shop matches when it does any of these.

quantity.description: Units needed. Drops shops whose stated minimum order is higher; shops with an unknown minimum stay.

query.description: What to make and where, in plain words, e.g. "sheet-metal bracket in Mexico" or "injection-molded enclosure, ISO 13485, not China". Processes, part words, materials, certifications and countries (including ruled-out ones) are read from it when the matching filter is not given.

startup_friendly_only.description: Only shops recorded as taking first, small runs.

name: find_manufacturers
title: Find manufacturers who can make a part
